description: 16-stage pipelined CORDIC, Q2.14 fixed point, rotation + vectoring modes, shift-add only (0 DSP).

clock_reset.clk: single clock (27 MHz on Tang Primer 20K)
clock_reset.clk_en: step enable; every register gated; tie 1 for full rate

status_protocol: streaming in_valid -> out_valid, fixed latency STAGES+1 clk_en beats

ports.name: x_in
ports.note: Q2.14; rotation: x init; vector: x sample

ports.name: z_in
ports.note: rotation: phase radians*2^14; vector: initial angle offset

validation.golden_source: tools/golden_model.py (independent fixed-point recurrence and Python-math-derived constants)

board.uart: 115200 report decoded on-board via fx2lafw LA (COM24 FTDI path broken on host)

standalone_synth.note: Historical ALU-enabled synthesis; retained as provenance, current -noalu metrics below

optimization_20260924.equivalence: 1057/1057 Yosys equivalence cells proven after async2sync
optimization_20260924.simulation: 4096 model vectors, quadrant/saturation, mixed mode, bubbles, clk_en, async reset PASS
optimization_20260924.board_full_rate: 27 MHz, 11 complete 32-sample streams; all x/y/z values and latency/cadence match
